name: Memorization
definition: The ability to remember information such as words, numbers, pictures, and procedures.

benchmark.name: Memory Task Suite
benchmark.model_or_system: MRA (Memory Recall Agent: LSTM + episodic memory + CPC, with jumpy backpropagation)
benchmark.metric: average human-normalized score across the suite, percent (holdout-interpolate split)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (typical human testers performing short visual, spatial and sequence memory tasks in 3D and Psychlab environments)

benchmark.name: LAMA
benchmark.model_or_system: BERT-large with P-tuning (frozen language model, trained continuous prompts)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population doing closed-book recall of encyclopedic world facts (place of birth, capital, official language, headquarters, occupation, and similar relations)

benchmark.name: Memory Maze
benchmark.metric: mean episode return on Memory Maze 15x15 (number of prompted targets reached per 4,000-step episode; human baseline about 67.7)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population doing a spatial and visual memory navigation task. This is the typical person who has to remember locations, object positions and layouts in work settings.

benchmark.name: LongMemEval
benchmark.metric: QA accuracy (%) judged by GPT-4o, LongMemEval_S (~115K tokens)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult / educated workforce doing closed-book recall of details from many prior conversations (e.g., an assistant or account manager recalling client-specific facts across ~50 sessions without re-reading notes)

benchmark.name: LongMemEval
benchmark.model_or_system: Hindsight (Vectorize) memory system with Gemini 3 Pro Preview backbone
benchmark.metric: percent accuracy (overall answer accuracy judged by an LLM, 500 questions, LongMemEval_S)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical adults who must retain and recall conversational and factual details over time without notes, such as client-facing staff, assistants and caseworkers.

benchmark.name: OpenAI-MRCR
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: people whose jobs require remembering and exactly reproducing verbal and numeric information, such as clerks, paralegals and analysts, working from memory without search tools.
